name: smwsprites-super-mario-advance
title: Super Mario Advance 4 !-Switch
description:
In certain e-reader levels from Super Mario Advance 4, this unique !-switch appears. It functions mostly the same as the ones from Yoshi's Island, where it makes outlined blocks solid, but this one can be grabbed and re-used as soon as the timer runs out.
The sprite requires UberASM to trigger Exanimation and decrease the timer. It also comes with a block, and requires 1 byte of freeram.

Requested by edidari.
